name: Quick yoga
description: 8 poses, 45 s each. A 6-minute flow that hits all the basics.

poses.name: Child's pose
poses.notes: Knees wide, big toes touching, forehead to the mat. Arms long in front.

poses.name: Cat-cow
poses.notes: Flow with the breath. 5 rounds either direction.

poses.name: Downward-facing dog
poses.notes: Heels reaching toward the floor. Strong arms, soft neck.

poses.name: Plank
poses.notes: Shoulders over wrists, body in one line. Drop the knees if it shakes.

poses.name: Cobra
poses.notes: Forearms or full extension. Lift the chest, soft glutes, gaze forward.

poses.name: Pigeon, right
poses.notes: Right shin across the mat, left leg long behind. Fold forward over the front shin.

poses.name: Pigeon, left
poses.notes: Mirror it. Notice if one side is tighter than the other.

poses.name: Savasana
poses.notes: Lie flat, palms up, eyes closed. Let the body sink into the floor.
